decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 25 O3). This RESTATES and NEVER OVERWRITES: DR 0053's rule 2 says a measurement does not improve, it is reproduced or superseded by a new measurement answering a new question — so 'what does the loop achieve under the adopted default' gets its own artifact and both committed incumbent artifacts stay exactly as they are. Only the MAP-Elites arm under `insertion` is re-run; the incumbent runs are read (rule 2 forbids re-running them), the GA control is read because run_ga_baseline takes no slip_admission and is structurally unaffected by the arm, and DR 0042's headline is read from its own artifact with its adopted-side counterpart read from N4's. The documented E4 gates are re-judged VERBATIM (judge_gates IMPORTED, never re-implemented, because a second copy could score the adopted arm by a rule the incumbent was never held to). THE GATE THAT CAN FAIL: a documented gate that PASSED under the incumbent and FAILS under the adopted default is a REGRESSION and a blocking finding, needing its own record rather than absorption into a restatement. A gate that was ALREADY failing is explicitly NOT a regression (DR 0032's GA-advantage clause has been refuted three times; blaming the arm for it would be a false accusation), and a gate that recovers is recorded but never offsets a regression.
